A small piece of paper with numbers that have the power to change a life forever! Okay... let's replace the paper with an app and one person with 600,000+ monthly users. This is our business!
 📌 Your Mission 
 As Cloud Engineer (m/f/d) you will modernize the Next Lotto Cloud platform and build a scalable, reliable foundation for our next stage of growth. You will lead the transition of our cloud environment to Terraform and Kubernetes, creating a robust and maintainable infrastructure setup. Working closely with our development teams, you will help improve scalability and system performance, establish the right observability, and empower engineers to identify and resolve bottlenecks independently. You will also build a pragmatic cloud governance framework that balances speed, security, and compliance - making it easy to onboard new team members, standardize best practices, and meet the requirements of our audits and certifications.
 🎯 Your Tasks & Responsibilities 
Import and manage our GCP environment in Terraform , and keep state and reality in sync.
 Migrate the current application landscape (App Engine and Compute Engine) to Kubernetes (GKE) and operate it in production.
 Own GCP IAM : roles, service accounts, least-privilege baseline, and the documentation auditors ask for.
 Tune autoscaling for applications and databases so we handle peaks without over-provisioning.
Build the observability our developers need - dashboards, alerts and performance trends they can read themselves.
 Track cloud cost, find the drivers, and drive the improvements.
 Help automating our CI/CD pipelines so teams can deploy to every environment safely and often.
Support our external audits and certifications with evidence, controls and answers.
Take part in incident response, and document what you build so you are not the only person who understands it.
 🏆 Your Impact in This Role 
Our production backend services run on GKE , with a documented rollback path.
The majority of our GCP resources are managed in Terraform , with drift visible and fixable.
 GCP cost per active user is flat or lower while our customer base grows.
A minimal viable IAM governance framework is in place and holds up in our next external audit.
New developers can be onboarded to the environment in days, not weeks, using documentation you wrote.
 🚀 Your Key Competencies 
 Must-have (Hard Skills): 
 Proven experience deploying and maintaining containerized workloads i n live production Kubernetes environments. 
Hands-on ability to manage infrastructure as code with Terraform, including resolving complex configuration drift without destroying resources.
Direct, practical experience building or operating real-world projects on Google Cloud Platform. 
 Strong diagnostics skills using metrics and logs to identify root causes rather than just surface symptoms.
Solid proficiency in building CI/CD pipelines and writing production-ready shell scripts.
Demonstrated ability to design, implement, and document Identity and Access Management policy architectures. 
 Nice-to-have: 
A software development background, ideally Java. 
Strong SQL and an understanding of database performance, ideally MySQL. 
Experience supporting external audits ( ISO 27001 or similar ).
 CKA certification or comparable.
Experience in a regulated industry ( gaming, fintech, health ).
 Soft Skills: 
You work autonomously in a remote setup and ask for support before you are stuck.
You explain your work clearly to people who are not infrastructure specialists, and you take feedback well.
You always see things to improve, but you prioritize by impact and can let the rest wait.
You value simplicity over perfection, and you document as you go.
You are comfortable being the only cloud specialist in the company.
 🎓 Your Background – Education & Experience 
A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent professional experience.
At least 2 years of experience as Cloud Engineer.
Preferred: a CNCF CKAD certificate or comparable.
Bonus: additional experience as software developer.
 🎁 What we offer you: 
 Remuneration & work-life balance: 
Competitive salary and trust-based working hours.
Private health insurance.
Generous training budget.
Extraordinary team events.
Meal benefit.
 Communication & trust: 
Open, honest and direct communication. Your ideas are welcome!
A feedback meeting every quarter to help us grow together.
We encourage innovation and are open to new ideas that push the boundaries.
 Modern working: 
Everything you need for your daily work: MacBook, monitor, headphones and more.
 Individual training: 
One training day per month and a generous training budget for your personal development.
 Buddy program: 
An experienced team member will support you from day one to help you get started.
 The team 
We are a colorful bunch from different nations and backgrounds. We don't distinguish by religion, gender, age, marital status... For us, the focus is on what you can do!
 🪴Our values: 
 MAKE IT HAPPEN 💪🏼 
Drive results - Own the problem, the goal, and the outcome through self-organization and decisions backed by data
Speak up with courage - Challenge ideas and raise issues directly when it matters
Getting things done - Be pragmatic, keep momentum, and bring the energy
Deliver quality impact - Ship solutions that move our mission and strategic goals forward
 WIN TOGETHER 💚 
Communicate openly and respectfully - Be transparent, assume positive intent, and set aside own ego when interacting with others
Help others win - Proactively share knowledge, time, and strengths in an interdisciplinary set-up
Work across cultures - Learn from others’ perspectives and actively refine own style for trust-based collaboration in a diverse team
Bring team spirit - Create moments of joy and belonging that fuel big outcomes together
 SHAPE THE FUTURE 🚀 
Experiment to learn - Run tests, measure outcomes, treat mistakes as an invitation to learn and adapt insights into action
Spot opportunities - Stay close to customers and market trends to identify what’s next
Build user-first innovation - Deliver trustworthy, data-driven solutions and services that set the bar
Grow yourself - Challenge and reflect on the way you work, seek feedback, and keep developing your skills
